ILCA 4 and ILCA 6 training camp · Poole Yacht Club

Winter Training Series - Christmas Camp

Dates
19–23 December 2026
Price
£450
Boats
ILCA 4 and ILCA 6
Coaches
James Foster and Kai Wolgram
Venue
Poole Yacht Club, The Yacht Haven, New Harbour Road West, Hamworthy, Poole BH15 4AQ

A five-day winter training block at Poole Yacht Club, continuing the technical and race-development work from the autumn series.

Main focus

A structured winter block for ILCA 4 and ILCA 6 sailors, with the detailed daily focus shaped around the group and conditions.

What to expect

  • High-quality winter water time
  • Technical and racecraft development
  • Video analysis
  • Individual feedback

Suitable for: ILCA 4 and 6 sailors, primarily those racing nationally with international aspirations.

Booking now open. Book by 28 November to avoid the £20 late booking fee.
